parameters.name: DestinationAddress
parameters.description: The service IP address of the backend instance.

parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint to which the backend instance belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
